name: Hilary
summary: At the Lakeshire docks, Hilary cries over the necklace she lost in Lake Everstill.

sections.title: A Child's Lost Keepsake
sections.body: Hilary waits in tears by the Lakeshire pier, afraid her father will be angry. She dropped the necklace he gave her into Lake Everstill, and hopes someone brave will dive in to find it. Gnoll invasions and Blackrock orc warbands press upon Lakeshire, but children there still face troubles of their own.

faq.answer: Hilary is a young human girl in Lakeshire, often found crying near the docks.
Hilary cries because the necklace her father bought for her slipped into Lake Everstill, and she fears his anger when he learns it is missing.

faq.q: Who is trying to help her find the necklace?
faq.answer: Her playmate Shawn sees her distress and asks passing adventurers to dive into Lake Everstill for her necklace.

faq.q: Where is the lost necklace located?
faq.answer: The necklace lies underwater in Lake Everstill, near the Lakeshire docks where Hilary dropped it.

angles.text: As the Redridge Mountains face larger troubles, helping Hilary brings a small measure of warmth and innocence to Lakeshire.
